recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, neon-saturated jungle scene set against a deep black void. The composition features stylized human figures and animals rendered in vibrant, clashing colors with heavy stippled textures and airbrushed glows, framed by dense, multi-colored foliage.
coreVisualRelationships: Neon figures against a central black negative space
Dense, layered foliage framing the top and sides
Stippled texture providing volume to flat color planes
Glow effects around central subjects and typography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central human figures at medium scale; large animal heads (elephant, tiger) flanking the lower and middle thirds.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central dancing figures and the glowing title text above them.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular flow from the top foliage, down the sides through the animals, meeting at the central figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: A large, solid black void in the upper-middle section creates a dramatic stage for the subjects.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Neon Green, Magenta, and Cyan (foliage and figures)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright Yellow and Red (highlights and glowing text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Maximum saturation against minimum value; colors appear to vibrate due to high-contrast boundaries.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely long, sweeping swashes and flourishes
Double-outline effect with a glowing outer halo
Variable stroke weight with sharp, pointed terminals
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial and terminal letters feature exaggerated descenders that wrap around other elements
Crossbars are integrated into the swash movement
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A secondary, smaller glowing script or sans-serif placed in the central void.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the organic, flowing structure of the primary text.
Captures the era-specific distortion and weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a psychedelic jungle scene with neon green, magenta, and cyan foliage framing a central black void. Include stippled textures on a purple elephant and a tiger. Place two tribal figures in the center on a red stippled ground.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom vector lettering at the top with long interlocking swashes in red with a yellow outline and a soft outer glow. Add a smaller glowing yellow subtitle in the center of the black void.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid deep black?
Are the colors neon and high-contrast?
Does the text feature interlocking swashes?
Is there a visible stippled texture on the figures?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is garbled or nonsensical if generated by AI.
Check that the stippling doesn't look like digital noise.
Verify the glow effect doesn't wash out the letterforms.
Confirm the black void remains deep and uncluttered.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine 1970s psychedelic poster aesthetics with Art Nouveau typography, using a high-contrast neon-on-black color scheme and stippled texture for volume.
